// A stand-in for the Gemini CLI's ACP module (bundle/gemini-<hash>.js), with
// its tool call written the way esbuild writes it, for cliPatches.test.ts.
// Read as text and patched; the patched copy is loaded as an ES module.

const require = (await import('node:module')).createRequire(import.meta.url);

function toToolCallContent(result) {
	return result.returnDisplay;
}

export class Session {
	constructor(id, config) {
		this.id = id;
		this.context = { config };
	}

	async runTool(invocation, fc) {
		const abortSignal = undefined;
		const callId = fc.id;
      const toolResult = await invocation.execute({
        abortSignal
      });
      const content = toToolCallContent(toolResult);
		return { llmContent: toolResult.llmContent, content };
	}
}
